description: The material libraries and textures of a model, and what draws (pack.ModelCheck.findings: textures, checkDrawn): mtllib and map_Kd paths relative to the OBJ's folder, missing files, materials without a texture, faces never drawn (HIDE, skip, CARGO_FILL). input: namespace (the declaring file's, for unqualified paths), declaration (the wagon model's JSON), files (ns:path -> text), present (locations that are there, contents unread: textures); any other key with a colon is a file too (what input_file reads of the example pack). A location is valid as Minecraft takes it: [a-z0-9_.-]+:[a-z0-9/._-]+. expected: the findings in the check's order (pack.ModelCheck.findings), each {severity: error | warning, finding}: code (ModelFinding.Code.key, as the editor names it: missing-texture), subject and index null, params (the names and numbers its line is made of, in the line's order), text (the line).

cases.note: every file there, the animation reads, the livery swaps a texture: nothing to say

files.t:car/car.obj:
mtllib car.mtl
v 0 0 0
v 1 0 0
v 1 1 0
v 0 1 0
vt 0 0
o BODY
usemtl body
f 1/1 2/1 3/1 4/1

cases.note: Blender writes "Dark Wood" whole in both files: it finds its texture
